items.title: College Football Playoff announces new 24-team format
items.summary: It was announced on Monday morning that the College Football Playoff and ESPN agreed on a five year deal worth $1.7 billion to expand the playoff field to 24-teams. The format would begin in the 27-28 season, marking this year's playoff as the last 12-team playoff.
